title: Two Gemini options join chat
summary:
Two Gemini chat models joined the text API, DeepSeek got room for longer answers, and the community project gallery grew.

The text API added `gemini`, based on Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite Preview, and `gemini-thinking`, based on Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental. One favors a lighter chat model; the other is configured to reason step by step when appropriate.

DeepSeek's response limit rose from 4,096 to 8,192 tokens. Audio requests that omit a voice now default to `amuch` instead of `alloy`.

The project lists gained AvatarStudio, a DescartesJS-based tool collection, a Chinese-language AI tools interface, and a Chinese children's storybook demo. The Elixpo listing was updated to Elixpo-Art, and the storybook entry introduced language and country metadata for non-English projects.

daily.title: Gemini Flash Lite chat
daily.text: Try `gemini`, based on Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite Preview, through the text API. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini).

daily.title: Gemini Thinking chat
daily.text: Try `gemini-thinking`, based on Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental and configured to reason step by step when appropriate. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-thinking).

daily.title: Longer DeepSeek responses
daily.text: DeepSeek can now return up to 8,192 tokens per response, twice its previous limit.
